Title: Public Preview: Long Term Retention for Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server

Body.Content:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server now offers a backup solution for supporting long term data retention and improved compliance for your PostgreSQL databases using Azure Backup. In preview, you now can leverage a rich set of capabilities such as flexible database backup policies, management of individual backups, and streamlined configuration. Additionally, you can add policies to backup and retain data for up to 10 years for compliance purposes.

Learn More.
